sources.title: QuerynAi/queryn-adapter-bge-m3_to_fastembed-bge-small · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Translates an embedding produced by bge-m3 into the embedding space of fastembed-bge-small, so a corpus already embedded with bge-m3 can be served against a fastembed-bge-small index without re-embedding it. Part of the Queryn embedding-translation engine.

sources.title: GitHub - Gigadelux/Queryn: Queryn is the engine for interoperability ...
sources.snippet: Project Abstract Queryn is an embedding translation and enrichment engine: given a text chunk and its existing embedding from Model A, it returns the equivalent embedding in Model B's space — without re-embedding the source corpus.
